label: Bitcoin in numbers
sub: supplement to chapters 1 and 2: price, supply and mining power since 2009
intro: The owner's dashboard of Bitcoin's price, supply and mining power, from Blockchain.com's public charts (snapshot of 25 September 2026), turned into course material with the chapter pages' tools: explorer, agents, concept map and playground. It makes chapter 1's supply schedule and chapter 2's security by computation visible.
